description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing to-do notes in a backend application. It provides endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing Spring Boot annotations and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller managing CRUD operations for to-do notes via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of notes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title, content, or completion status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
